patthana23.49:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
patthana23.49:2.1: na asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
patthana23.49:3.1: na nevasekhānāsekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho nevasekhānāsekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na parittaṃ
